$why: THE PIPELINE'S TOOLS, ON A SET WHERE THE AGENT RUNS THEM THROUGH ITS SHELL.
Each is named by a variable from config/pipeline-tool-commands.json, which the hub exports — the
agent's shell resolves it, so no local path is written into the prompt (operator, 2026-10-01).
Chosen by lib/pipeline-tools.js; the counterpart is pipeline-tools-hosted.
description: Tells an agent which pipeline tools it has, on a set where it runs them through its shell.
body:
YOUR TOOLS — run each with your shell tool exactly as written (the variables are already set in your environment, and you work at the repository root):
  bash "$EPAM_CODEGRAPH_TOOL" explore <domain nouns>
  bash "$EPAM_CODEGRAPH_TOOL" query <SymbolName>      # exact definition + signature + import path
  bash "$EPAM_CODEGRAPH_TOOL" callers <SymbolName>
  bash "$EPAM_CODEGRAPH_TOOL" callees <SymbolName>
  bash "$EPAM_CODEGRAPH_TOOL" show <file> [startLine] [endLine]
  bash "$EPAM_SEARCH_TOOL" --string "<exact symbol>" [--glob "*.ts"]
  bash "$EPAM_SEARCH_TOOL" --file "<part of a filename>"
  bash "$EPAM_PACKAGE_SYMBOL_TOOL" "<package name>" "<method or function name>"   # a third-party symbol's real declared shape and documented usage
